items.mainDefect: The health-check guard `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` is always False for SpawnProcess instances, so `process.kill()` never runs and unhealthy flusher processes are never reaped before a new one is spawned.

secondary.defect: The same `isinstance(process, multiprocessing.Process)` guard in join() is always False for SpawnProcess, so `process.terminate()` is never called there.
